lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Highly ordered vertical columns of circular high-luminance blobs; approximately 4-6 spots per column in the immediate post-gill region, transitioning to a more sparse distribution towards the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with circular blobs to form a regular grid-like lattice; most prominent in the lateral mid-section between the gills and the first dorsal fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Primary longitudinal ridge visible as a sharp horizontal luminance gradient (highlighted upper edge, shadowed lower edge) running from the posterior gill margin toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 5-7 distinct high-luminance blobs distributed across the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, primarily clustered along the anterior and middle sections.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two small, slender appendages (likely remoras) attached to the flank: one posterior to the pectoral fin and one posterior to the first dorsal fin. Subtle irregularities on the trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Intricate pattern of radiating spots and short horizontal striations concentrated on the upper lobe of the caudal fin.
